quarterly_data.quarter: NextEra Energy press release: The United States Department of Commerce and the Government (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Project Star: the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Republic of Korea selected Related Companies and NextEra Energy Resources, in partnership with Lewis Energy Group, to develop a $22.3 billion energy infrastructure campus in Encinal, Texas with 6.47 GW of natural gas generation. At full scale it will support a privately funded 5 GW data center campus that Related Digital is developing on an adjacent site and deliver excess power back to the grid. NextEra Energy Resources and Related plan to develop, build and operate the gas-powered generation (NextEra 'would build and operate the gas plant'); Lewis Energy provides the land, produced water and natural gas supply. The campus will be owned jointly by the Republic of Korea and the U.S. under the joint trade agreement structure, and the team is expected to leverage Korean companies' technology and supply chain. Development is expected in phases, with initial generating resources anticipated to come online as early as 2029, subject to required permitting and approvals. NextEra says it has invested over $20 billion and operates more than 9 GW of generation in Texas. CEO John Ketchum: 'By bringing new generation online to serve new demand, we're helping strengthen reliability'.
